155:   void doQueryFirstScoring(Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost[] dims)

157:     setScorer(collector, ScoreCachingWrappingScorer.wrap(baseScorer));
158: 
159:     // Specialize the single-dim use-case as we have a more efficient implementation for that:
160:     if (dims.length == 1) {
161:       doQueryFirstScoringSingleDim(acceptDocs, collector, dims[0]);
162:       return;
163:     }

165:     // Sort our sideways dims by approximation cost so we can advance the lower cost ones first:
166:     List<DocsAndCost> sidewaysDims = new ArrayList<>(dims.length);
167:     sidewaysDims.addAll(List.of(dims));
168:     CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysDims, APPROXIMATION_COMPARATOR);

177:         }

179:       }
180:     }
181:     if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
182:       CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysTwoPhaseDims, TWO_PHASE_COMPARATOR);
183:     }

186:     // has advanced beyond the docID the rest of the dimensions are positioned on. This functions
187:     // a bit like the "head" queue in WANDScorer's "min should match" implementation. We use a
188:     // single-valued PQ ordered by docID to easily determine the "closest" runaway dim we'll use
189:     // for advancing in the case that multiple dim approximations miss.
190:     PriorityQueue<DocsAndCost> runawayDim =
191:         new PriorityQueue<>(1) {
192:           @Override
193:           protected boolean lessThan(DocsAndCost a, DocsAndCost b) {
194:             return a.approximation.docID() < b.approximation.docID();
195:           }
196:         };

198:     int docID = baseApproximation.docID();
199: 
200:     nextDoc:
201:     while (docID != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
202:       assert docID == baseApproximation.docID();
203: 
204:       if (acceptDocs != null && acceptDocs.get(docID) == false) {
205:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
206:         continue;
207:       }
208: 
209:       // If we carried a "runaway" over from the last iteration, see if we've "caught up" yet:
210:       DocsAndCost runaway = runawayDim.top();
211:       if (runaway != null && runaway.approximation.docID() <= docID) {
212:         runawayDim.clear();
213:         runaway = null;
214:       }
215: 
216:       // Check the sideways dim approximations. At most, one dim is allowed to miss for the doc
217:       // to be a near-miss or full match. If multiple sideways dims miss, we move on:
218:       for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysDims) {
219:         int dimDocID = advanceIfBehind(docID, dim.approximation);
220:         if (dimDocID != docID && dim != runaway) {
221:           DocsAndCost evicted = runawayDim.insertWithOverflow(dim);
222:           if (evicted != null) {
223:             // More than one dim has advanced beyond docID, so we jump ahead to the "closer" of
224:             // the two:
225:             int next = evicted.approximation.docID();
226:             docID = baseApproximation.advance(next);
227:             continue nextDoc;
228:           }
229:         }
230:       }
231: 
232:       // At this point, we have an "approximate" near-miss or full match, but we still need
233:       // to confirm two-phase iterators. First, check the base two-phase (it's always required):
234:       if (baseTwoPhase != null && baseTwoPhase.matches() == false) {
235:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
236:         continue;
237:       }
238: 
239:       // If we have two-phase iterators for our sideways dims, check them now. At most, one
240:       // sideways dim can miss for the doc to be a near-miss or full match. If more than one misses
241:       // we move on:
242:       DocsAndCost failedDim = runawayDim.top();
243:       if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
244:         if (failedDim == null) {
245:           // If all sideways dims matched in their approximation phase, then we can allow one
246:           // second-phase check to fail:
247:           for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
248:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
249:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
250:               if (failedDim != null) {
251:                 // Two second-phase checks have failed, so we move on:
252:                 docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
253:                 continue nextDoc;
254:               } else {
255:                 failedDim = dim;
256:               }
257:             }
258:           }
259:         } else {
260:           // If a sideways dim failed the approximate check, then no second-phase checks can fail:
261:           for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
262:             if (failedDim == dim) {
263:               continue;
264:             }
265:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
266:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
267:               docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
268:               continue nextDoc;
269:             }
270:           }
271:         }
272:       }
273: 
274:       collectDocID = docID;
275:       if (failedDim == null) {
276:         // Hit passed all filters, so it's "real":
277:         collectHit(collector, sidewaysDims);
278:       } else {
279:         // Hit missed exactly one dim:
280:         collectNearMiss(failedDim.sidewaysLeafCollector);
281:       }
282: 
283:       docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
284:     }
285:   }

289:       return iterator.advance(docID);
290:     } else {
291:       return iterator.docID();
292:     }
